attributes.census_tooling_gap_found: The debt census (`memory_graph/core.py fakematch_debt`, regex `_DEBT_CAST_RE` + `_cast_site_is_named`) checks only for the LITERAL substring 'offsetof' or 'sizeof' within 240 chars forward of a cast site's own statement. This TU's local `#define IOFF(f) (offsetof(iteminfo,item)+offsetof(iteminfodata,f))` macro (InitWorldInfo's item-info swap loop, ~24 sites) is ALREADY fully offsetof-resolved at every call site but is counted as 'bare' by the census because the call-site text reads 'IOFF(coltype)' with no literal 'offsetof' substring nearby - confirmed by inspection, left unconverted (already correct, converting would just inline-expand a working macro for no reason). This inflates the pre-pass 160 bare_sites figure by roughly 24-28 sites; a future census improvement could special-case macro names whose #define body contains offsetof/sizeof.

attributes.law_screen: Screened all 12 core-screen laws via `laws --tag core-screen --full 1`. claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web (APPLIED, primary lever): wave-1 had left the WorldSaveInitState/WorldRestoreInitState wobjsp field displacements and InitWorldInfo's animdata swap loop fully raw specifically because a TYPED ALIAS regressed the analogous wobjs/coltri loops (real 64->68, 0->21); this law says the alias/web hazard laws govern TYPE changes only, and a bare-hex-to-offsetof SPELLING change on the SAME raw pointer is near-guaranteed neutral - re-tested and confirmed on both regions (see conversions). claim.law.offsetof-overturns-typed-alias-caps (screened, not directly invoked): no PRIOR cap in this TU was recorded without its failing form documented (both known caps here name the exact typed-alias form that failed), so there was no undocumented-form cap to overturn this pass - the offsetof-rename law alone accounted for every conversion. claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing (screened, informs form choice): confirms the danger is specifically a TYPED intermediate on a multi-field walked pointer (InitWorldInfo's animdata loop touches 9 fields/iteration) - motivated keeping the raw-pointer+offsetof form rather than trying a typed struct pointer, which this law predicts would regress. claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast / lwzu-idiom-web-retention / pointer-walk-array-index-regression / recomputed-index-array-form-safe / scalar-read-write-lfsu-mixed-form / walked-base-symbol-identity / offsetof-fused-immediate-counter / offsetof-rename-array-member-boundary / large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression: screened, none directly applicable this pass (no typed-alias attempts made; no >4000-insn batch; no array-member-base offsetof case; no scalar read+write-same-address pair touched; no walked-base symbol ambiguity in the touched regions).
attributes.left_raw_reconfirmed: Re-screened every wave-1 left-raw region under the new laws; all remain genuinely unresolvable (checked `gdlmem.py struct <name>` for each - no PDB match): (1) DoWorldAnimSub stream-header d+0/2/4 - little-endian FILE FORMAT bytes read before any struct exists, not a runtime struct member. (2) InitWorldInfo ctris loop's +0x00/+0x02/+0x20/+0x22/+0x24/+0x26/+0x04/+0x14 (coltri header/tail) - `gdlmem struct coltri/COLTRI/triangle` all no-match; coltri is this TU's own local struct with only .pos GC-verified. (3) gridrow loop +0x00/+0x02/+0x04 - GRIDROW is forward-declared opaque in worldinfo.h, `gdlmem struct gridrow/gridentry` no-match, no body exists anywhere to offsetof against. (4) InitWorldInfo iteminst switch-case payload (11 case arms, +0x30..0x3A) - iteminst.params is `u8 params[12]` (game/item.h) with NO per-type breakdown; verified the sibling TU game/world/items.c treats the identical field the same opaque way (SetItem/other consumers all use raw `params[N]` with no named sub-struct) - inventing per-type names here would contradict AGENTS.md's 'never invent names' rule. None of these are IOFF-macro false positives (see below) - they are genuinely un-nameable.
